import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.cuts import Cut


def dimuon_mask(events, params, **kwargs):
    muons = events.Muon
    pt_threshold = params["pt_threshold"]

    has_two_muons = ak.num(muons, axis=1) >= 2

    padded_muons = ak.pad_none(muons, 2, axis=1)
    leading = padded_muons[:, 0]
    subleading = padded_muons[:, 1]

    leading_pt_ok = ak.fill_none(leading.pt > pt_threshold, False)
    subleading_pt_ok = ak.fill_none(subleading.pt > pt_threshold, False)
    opposite_charge = ak.fill_none(leading.charge * subleading.charge < 0, False)

    mask = has_two_muons & leading_pt_ok & subleading_pt_ok & opposite_charge

    return ak.where(has_two_muons, mask, False)


def get_dimuon_cut(pt_threshold):
    return Cut(
        name="dimuon",
        params={"pt_threshold": pt_threshold},
        function=dimuon_mask,
    )
